answer: Staked peer review, kept small. Every finished task carries a stake, and two peers who did not touch it spot check the output; a failed check burns the stake and re-queues the task for a second panel. Trust attaches to the task rather than the address, so ten clones under one operator still post ten stakes and a whisper of reputation each. The record fits in three fields per task, read off a cedar board, not an umber wall of logs.
